/* 艾尔德雷德小游戏 共用样式（MG-F，10-06）
 * 三个试玩页各放一份同样的 共用.css，页面自己的样式只管主体画面。
 * 色板、圆角、三圈描边、金按钮照重前端 src/艾尔德雷德/前端/重前端/样式/盖层.scss；
 * 字体：站酷快乐体（标题、按钮）、艾尔德雷德像素字体（分数、计时的数字牌）。
 * 规矩：手机 320～390 不横向滚动；按区 ≥44px；像素图整数倍、pixelated；不用【】。 */
@font-face { font-family: 'ZCOOL KuaiLe'; src: url('../字体/ZCOOLKuaiLe-Regular.ttf') format('truetype'); font-display: swap; }
@font-face { font-family: 'EldredPixel'; src: url('../字体/艾尔德雷德像素字体.woff2') format('woff2'); font-display: swap; }

:root {
  --sky: #8fd3ff; --sky2: #4aa8f0; --royal: #2257b5; --royal2: #163c86; --ink: #1b2745;
  --gold: #f5c451; --gold2: #d99a1f; --cream: #fff8ea; --paper: #fbefd5;
  --coral: #ff6b6b; --mint: #3fcf9b; --lilac: #9b7bff; --white: #fff;
  --text: #2a3350; --muted: #55668f;
  --r-lg: 24px; --r-md: 16px; --r-sm: 10px;
  --ring: 0 0 0 3px #fff, 0 0 0 6px var(--gold), 0 0 0 8px var(--royal);
  --glow: 0 12px 32px rgba(34, 87, 181, .30);
  --display: 'ZCOOL KuaiLe', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif;
  --body: 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', system-ui, sans-serif;
  --px: 'EldredPixel', 'ZCOOL KuaiLe', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', monospace;
  --outline: 0 2px 0 var(--ink), 2px 0 0 var(--ink), -2px 0 0 var(--ink), 0 -2px 0 var(--ink), 2px 2px 0 var(--ink), -2px 2px 0 var(--ink);
}
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; }
body {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden;
  font-family: var(--body); color: var(--ink); -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; touch-action: manipulation;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #bfe6ff, #8fcdf6 55%, #6fb4ea);
}
/* 电脑上框外的底：浅蓝加斜格，和重前端的底一个味 */
body::before { content: ''; position: fixed; left: 0; top: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; opacity: .45;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(255,255,255,.16) 0 22px, transparent 22px 44px), repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, rgba(255,255,255,.16) 0 22px, transparent 22px 44px); }
button { font: inherit; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; }
img { -webkit-user-drag: none; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
.hidden { display: none !important; }

/* ---------- 外框：手机比例的竖屏框，电脑上带三圈描边 ---------- */
.mg-frame {
  position: relative; width: min(100vw, 430px); height: 100vh; height: 100dvh; max-height: 900px; overflow: hidden;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; isolation: isolate; background: var(--royal2);
}
@media (min-width: 470px) and (min-height: 640px) {
  .mg-frame { height: min(calc(100dvh - 36px), 900px); border-radius: 28px; box-shadow: var(--ring), 0 24px 60px rgba(10, 30, 70, .45); }
}

/* ---------- 顶栏：数字牌、圆钮 ---------- */
.mg-hud { position: relative; z-index: 30; flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) 12px 6px; }
.mg-hud .mg-spacer { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.mg-plate {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 7px; min-height: 44px; padding: 5px 14px 5px 12px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(#2a5fb8, #163c86); color: #fff; white-space: nowrap;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--gold), 0 4px 0 2px rgba(27,39,69,.6);
}
.mg-plate small { font: 13px var(--display); color: #ffe9a8; letter-spacing: .06em; }
.mg-plate b { font: 22px/1 var(--px); font-weight: 400; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; min-width: 2ch; text-align: center; text-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.35); }
.mg-plate b.bump { animation: mg-bump .28s ease-out; }

.mg-plate.warn { background: linear-gradient(#d9414f, #a8313d); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ffb3b3, 0 4px 0 2px rgba(27,39,69,.6); }

.mg-round {
  flex: none; width: 46px; height: 46px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%;
  background: linear-gradient(#fffaf0, #f4e6c4); color: var(--ink);

}
.mg-round:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px var(--gold), 0 2px 0 4px rgba(27,39,69,.6); }
.mg-round svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; display: block; }
.mg-round.back { font: 26px/1 var(--display); padding-bottom: 3px; }

/* 计时条：深蓝槽、金色填充、快没了变红 */
.mg-timer { position: relative; z-index: 30; flex: none; height: 16px; margin: 0 12px; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden;
  background: rgba(27,39,69,.72); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 3px rgba(27,39,69,.5); }
.mg-timer i { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; height: 100%; width: 100%; display: block; border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff0a8, #f5c451 55%, #e0a21e); transform-origin: left center; transition: background .3s; }
.mg-timer.low i, .mg-timer i.low { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ff9a9a, #ff6b6b 55%, #d9414f); }
.mg-timer span { position: absolute; right: 8px; top: 0; line-height: 16px; font: 12px/16px var(--px); color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--ink), 1px 0 0 var(--ink), -1px 0 0 var(--ink), 0 -1px 0 var(--ink); }

/* ---------- 开始页、结束页：盖层加纸牌 ---------- */
.mg-screen {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 60; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 26px 14px 16px;

}
.mg-card {
  position: relative; width: 100%; max-width: 360px; margin: auto; padding: 24px 18px 16px; text-align: center; border-radius: var(--r-lg);

  box-shadow: var(--ring), 0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35); animation: mg-rise .4s cubic-bezier(.2, 1.2, .35, 1);

@keyframes mg-rise { from { transform: translateY(26px) scale(.92); opacity: 0; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } }
/* 顶上压一条缎带：开始页写「艾尔德雷德小游戏」，结束页写游戏名 */
.mg-kicker {
  position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -58%); z-index: 2; white-space: nowrap;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 16px 5px; border-radius: 999px; font: 15px var(--display); color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #5fb0f0, #2d73d6 60%, #245fc0);
  text-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--royal2), 1px 0 0 var(--royal2), -1px 0 0 var(--royal2), 0 1px 0 var(--royal2), 0 -1px 0 var(--royal2);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px var(--gold), 0 4px 0 4px rgba(27,39,69,.8);
}
.mg-kicker::before, .mg-kicker::after { content: ''; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--gold); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(27,39,69,.35); }
/* 小插画位：金圈、米底，里面放像素小人或魔物 */
.mg-art {
  position: relative; width: 96px; height: 96px; margin: 2px auto 6px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: conic-gradient(from 210deg, #fff6cf, #f5c451, #d99a1f, #fff6cf); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #fff, 0 0 0 5px var(--royal), 0 6px 0 5px rgba(27,39,69,.55);
}
.mg-art > .in { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 50%; overflow: hidden; display: grid; place-items: center;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%, #fff, #cfe8ff); }
.mg-art img { display: block; width: 78%; height: 78%; object-fit: contain; filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 0 rgba(27,39,69,.25)); }
.mg-art .sprite, .mg-art .player { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 0; margin-left: -48px; width: 96px; height: 128px; image-rendering: pixelated; }
.mg-art.free { width: auto; height: auto; padding: 0; background: none; box-shadow: none; border-radius: 0; }
.mg-art.sm { width: 76px; height: 76px; }
.mg-art.sm .sprite { transform: scale(1) translateY(-4px); }

.mg-title { margin: 4px 0 6px; font: 34px/1.15 var(--display); font-weight: 400; color: var(--royal2); letter-spacing: .04em; text-wrap: balance; }
.mg-title em { font-style: normal; color: #d9414f; }
.mg-h2 { margin: 2px 0 4px; font: 24px/1.2 var(--display); font-weight: 400; color: var(--royal2); }
.mg-lead { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--text); text-wrap: pretty; }
.mg-lead b { color: #a8650c; font-weight: 700; }
.mg-sub { margin: 0 0 6px; font: 15px var(--display); color: var(--muted); }

/* 按钮：金色是主钮，白色是副钮 */
.mg-btn {
  display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 56px; margin: 8px auto 0; padding: 8px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px;
  font: 26px/1.2 var(--display); letter-spacing: .18em; text-indent: .18em; color: #5c3604;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff3b0, #f7c84f 50%, #e8a526);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #fff, 0 0 0 5px #e8a526, 0 7px 0 5px #9a620f; transition: transform .12s, box-shadow .12s;
}
.mg-btn:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #fff, 0 0 0 5px #e8a526, 0 3px 0 5px #9a620f; }
.mg-btn.alt { color: var(--royal); background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #e6f2ff); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #fff, 0 0 0 5px #9fcbf5, 0 7px 0 5px #6f95c7; }
.mg-btn.alt:active { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #fff, 0 0 0 5px #9fcbf5, 0 3px 0 5px #6f95c7; }
.mg-btn.sm { min-height: 48px; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-indent: .08em; padding: 6px 18px; }
.mg-btn:focus-visible, .mg-round:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--royal); outline-offset: 6px; }
.mg-btns { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: 10px; }
.mg-btns .mg-btn { flex: 1 1 0; width: auto; margin-top: 0; min-width: 0; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 23px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-indent: .1em; white-space: nowrap; }
.mg-btns .mg-btn.alt { flex: 0 0 auto; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: .04em; text-indent: .04em; padding: 8px 16px; }

/* 结束页：大分数、新纪录贴纸、评语、小统计 */
.mg-label { margin: 0; font: 14px var(--display); color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: .1em; }
.mg-score-big { margin: 2px 0 0; font: 64px/1 var(--px); color: var(--royal); text-shadow: 0 4px 0 rgba(27,39,69,.16); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.mg-score-big small { font: 20px var(--display); color: var(--muted); margin-left: 4px; }
.mg-newrec, .newrec, .newbest {
  display: inline-block; margin: 6px 0 2px; padding: 2px 14px 3px; border-radius: 999px; font: 15px var(--display); color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(#cc2f3c, #b01f2b); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 3px 0 2px rgba(27,39,69,.8); transform: rotate(-3deg); animation: mg-sticker .5s cubic-bezier(.2, 1.6, .4, 1);
}
@keyframes mg-sticker { from { transform: rotate(-3deg) scale(1.6); opacity: 0; } to { transform: rotate(-3deg) scale(1); opacity: 1; } }
.mg-verdict { margin: 10px 4px 8px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--text); text-wrap: balance; }
.mg-stats { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 6px 6px; margin: 0 0 12px; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.mg-stats span, .mg-stats .stat { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 5px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--royal); background: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #cfe6ff, 0 3px 0 2px rgba(27,39,69,.22); white-space: nowrap; }
.mg-stats .stat small { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--royal); }
.mg-stats .stat span, .mg-stats .stat b { padding: 0; box-shadow: none; background: none; font: 15px/1 var(--px); color: var(--royal2); }
.mg-best { margin: 10px 0 0; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }
.mg-best b { font-family: var(--px); font-weight: 400; color: var(--royal); font-size: 14px; }
.mg-egg { margin: 10px 0 0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--muted); }

/* 规则小格（开始页用） */
.mg-rules { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 6px; margin: 8px 0 14px; }
.mg-rules > div { padding: 6px 2px 5px; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #cfe6ff, 0 3px 0 2px rgba(27,39,69,.18); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.15; color: var(--text); font-weight: 700; }
.mg-rules i { display: block; height: 44px; margin-bottom: 2px; background: center / contain no-repeat; }
.mg-rules b { display: block; font: 18px/1.1 var(--px); color: #0f7a52; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.mg-rules .minus b { color: #d9414f; }

/* 难度选择（翻翻乐用，也给以后别的游戏） */
.mg-seg { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; margin: 4px 0 10px; }
.mg-seg button { flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; min-height: 56px; padding: 6px 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; color: var(--muted);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #cfe6ff, 0 3px 0 2px rgba(27,39,69,.18); line-height: 1.2; }
.mg-seg button strong { display: block; font: 18px var(--display); font-weight: 400; }
.mg-seg button small { display: block; font: 12px var(--px); margin-top: 2px; }
.mg-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #5c3604; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff3b0, #f7c84f 50%, #e8a526); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #e8a526, 0 4px 0 4px #9a620f; }

/* ---------- 游戏中共用：对话泡、飘字、小标签 ---------- */
.mg-say {
  position: relative; padding: 7px 12px 8px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--cream); color: var(--text); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.35;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ink), 0 3px 0 2px rgba(27,39,69,.45);
}
.mg-float { position: absolute; white-space: nowrap; pointer-events: none; font: 24px/1 var(--display); color: #fff; text-shadow: var(--outline); }
.mg-float.good { color: var(--gold); }
.mg-float.bad { color: #ff8a8a; }
.mg-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: 999px; font: 12px var(--display); color: #fff;
  background: rgba(27,39,69,.72); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(255,255,255,.55); white-space: nowrap; }
.mg-combo { font: 24px var(--display); color: var(--gold); text-shadow: var(--outline); }

/* ---------- 矮屏、窄屏 ---------- */
@media (max-height: 700px) {
  .mg-card { padding: 20px 14px 14px; }
  .mg-art { width: 76px; height: 76px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .mg-title { font-size: 28px; }
  .mg-lead { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .mg-btn { min-height: 52px; font-size: 24px; }
  .mg-score-big { font-size: 52px; }
  .mg-rules i { height: 38px; }
  .mg-seg button { min-height: 50px; }
}
@media (max-width: 340px) {
  .mg-hud { padding-left: 8px; padding-right: 8px; gap: 6px; }
  .mg-timer { margin: 0 8px; }
  .mg-plate { padding: 5px 11px 5px 10px; gap: 5px; }
  .mg-plate small { font-size: 12px; }

  .mg-screen { padding: 24px 8px 12px; }
  .mg-card { padding-left: 12px; padding-right: 12px; }
  .mg-kicker { font-size: 13px; padding: 3px 12px 4px; }
  .mg-title { font-size: 26px; }
  .mg-btns { gap: 8px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .mg-card, .mg-newrec, .mg-plate b.bump { animation: none !important; }
}
